public.text: The strategic body is expected to safeguard equity and sustainability, but no measurable indicators or reporting obligations are specified.
public.suggestedRevision: Require an annual public governance report covering access and coverage, service performance, equity impacts, financial sustainability, standards conformance, incidents, architecture exceptions, stakeholder participation, and corrective actions.
